description: This file defines the ImageDialog class for the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, handling image insertion dialogs including UI setup, event binding, and dialog display logic.

classes.name: ImageDialog
classes.description: Class managing the image insertion dialog in Summernote editor.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ImageDialog with the given editor context.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI elements and appends it to the container.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Hides and removes the dialog from DOM.

methods.name: bindEnterKey
methods.description: Binds Enter key press event to trigger the button click.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the image dialog and handles image insertion upon user action.

methods.name: showImageDialog
methods.description: Creates and shows the image input dialog, returning a promise that resolves with user input.
